column1: # Numbers & time for Nihongo::Numbers & Time (python3 main.py --seed-numbers), in study order.
# Each card is an expression as it's written in real life (3本, 午後2時, 2:30, 3月14日, ¥1,980),
#   and the card back gives its reading. The point is the sound changes (さんぼん, よじ,
#   いっぷん, ついたち) and reading mixed formats. Single words (一人, 二日, 去年, 毎日,
#   the weekdays) are in words.tsv; the phrase cards at the end combine them.
# Hand-made on 2026-11-06 (user's request), N5/N4 level. Hand edits are fine.
#   becomes a tag), front (as written), kana (the reading), meaning, note (faded on the card).
